links.comparator_used: Original model trained on internal data and applied unchanged to the external VHA cohort
links.outcome: Discrimination (AUROC) for prolonged opioid use prediction in the VHA cohort
links.effect: AUROC fell from 0.74 (internal test) to 0.70 (full external cohort) with the original model; retraining on VHA data improved AUROCs to 0.82
links.tradeoff: External validation and retraining revealed performance and utility shifts across subgroups, with systematic shifts in net-benefit across threshold probabilities.
links.quote: Retraining on VHA data improved AUROCs to 0.82.

design_hint: external validation and local retraining with subgroup fairness and clinical utility assessment
